name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention: domain=dialog, descriptor accurately describes the action (back up the dialog area into a heap buffer). No Ghidra address residue in the name; no domain ID involved. Name correctly reflects the save-under snapshot behavior.
purpose: Save-under snapshot: copies the 0x48x0x48 (72x72) pixel region of the working framebuffer around the cursor into a freshly-allocated heap buffer so it can be restored after an overlaid settings/status dialog is closed.
logic_summary: If data_fd2_dialog_area_backup_buffer is non-NULL, free it. malloc 0x1440 (=0x48*0x48=5184) bytes and store the pointer in data_fd2_dialog_area_backup_buffer. Compute source anchor = data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr + 0x8088 + (cursor_screen_x-1)*0x18 + (cursor_screen_y-1)*0x2AC0 (top-left corner one tile up/left of the cursor, giving a 1-tile margin). Loop row=0..0x47: memmove 0x48 bytes from src into backup_buffer+row*0x48, advancing src by the working-buffer row stride 0x1C8 each iteration. The decompiler-visible __CHK(0x18) is the Watcom compiler-generated stack-overflow probe, not game logic.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effect: (re)allocates and fills data_fd2_dialog_area_backup_buffer with the snapshot.

notes: Source comment block (dialog.c lines 678-695) is already concise and accurate: it correctly states the 0x48x0x48 snapshot, the save-under purpose, free/malloc(0x1440)/copy sequence, the -1-tile source anchor with 0x18/0x2AC0 strides, the 0x1C8 working-buffer row stride, and the caller/inverse relationship (fd2_open_settings_dialog_with_slide / fd2_restore_dialog_area_from_buffer). No edit needed. Ghidra plate is a consistent superset (adds body pseudocode), no contradiction -> plate left untouched. Only caller is fd2_open_settings_dialog_with_slide @ 0x1741c (single UNCONDITIONAL_CALL xref from 0x174e7), which calls it once before the 4-frame slide animation; inverse fd2_restore_dialog_area_from_buffer @ 0x17643 uses the same anchor/stride formula, confirming the geometry.
